specification.problem: Simulate the reduced BCS/Richardson pairing Hamiltonian on N pair-level qubits (hard-core bosons / pseudospins) via Trotterization, optionally prepare the ground state adiabatically, and read out eigenenergies by Trotterized quantum phase estimation.
specification.reconstruction_scope: One tiny instance: N=3 pair levels (assumed eps_j = j, G=0.5 rescaled), first-order Trotter, QPE with t=4 ancillas, reference state with one pair (one qubit flipped). The paper's other algorithms for different native Hamiltonians (Ising/XY/other), fidelity studies, and complexity comparisons are outside scope beyond a gate-count note. The exact paper algorithms are not specified in the abstract.

equations.label: Pairing Hamiltonian
equations.description: Reduced pairing Hamiltonian with pair levels as hard-core bosons.
equations.abstract_quote: we propose a complete set of algorithms for simulating pairing Hamiltonians
equations.justification: The abstract names pairing Hamiltonians; the explicit BCS form is background and from the sketch, not the abstract.

equations.label: Qubit form
equations.description: Jordan-Wigner-free spin mapping with |1>=occupied pair, n_j=(1-Z_j)/2, P_j^+=sigma^+_j; the diagonal j=k terms give -G sum_j n_j which is absorbed into eps_j -> eps_j - G. Last term is zero and just notational.
equations.justification: sigma^+_j sigma^-_k + h.c. = (X_jX_k+Y_jY_k)/2; the sketch's Z/2 convention differs from this one only by a constant and sign convention for |1>=occupied.
assumptions: Constant energy shifts dropped or tracked classically

equations.label: Trotter step
equations.description: First-order Trotter product. XX and YY terms commute for the same pair, so each pair factor is exactly RXX*RYY with angle -G dt/r (Qiskit RXX(theta)=exp(-i theta XX/2)).
equations.justification: Standard product formula applied to the sketch's Hamiltonian; the abstract gives no schedule.
assumptions: Non-adjacent pairs via SWAP chains if linear connectivity is required

equations.label: Adiabatic path
equations.description: Linear-schedule adiabatic preparation from the reference state, and fidelity with the exact ground state by statevector overlap.
equations.justification: Abstract states that the fidelity of target states is numerically studied; the linear schedule is an assumed choice.
assumptions: Ground state in the fixed pair-number sector

equations.label: QPE eigenphase
equations.description: Phase-estimation readout of energy: controlled-U^(2^k) on ancilla k, then inverse QFT.
equations.abstract_quote: we design a measurement scheme to extract energy spectra from the simulators
equations.justification: The abstract only says a spectrum measurement scheme exists; the QPE details are from the sketch and background.
assumptions: Spectrum rescaled to fit one 2pi window of the phase

equations.label: Counts to phase
equations.description: Convert ancilla counts string (Qiskit little-endian, ancilla k = rightmost bit k) to phase if ancilla register measured into classical bits 0..t-1 in order.
equations.justification: Qiskit bit ordering convention with the standard inverse QFT including swaps.

registers.name: sys
registers.role: pair-level qubits, qubit j = level j, |1> occupied

registers.name: anc
registers.role: QPE energy readout; ancilla k controls U^(2^k)

specification.initial_state: sys: reference product state with lowest-level pairs filled by X gates (e.g. |001> for one pair on level 0); anc: H on all giving |+>^t. For multiple peaks use a superposition or the adiabatic state.

steps.description: Choose rescaled eps_j, G, dt so the spectrum fits one 2pi window; prepare the reference state with X gates.
Optionally run the adiabatic Trotterized evolution and compute the statevector fidelity (no measurements).
Apply H to ancillas and controlled-U^(2^k) built from controlled RZ, RXX, RYY (or CX-RZ-CX) Trotter steps.
Apply inverse QFT to ancillas and measure only ancillas.
Convert counts to phases and energies.

specification.measurement: Measure the t ancilla qubits into classical bits 0..t-1 (ancilla k to bit k); system qubits unmeasured.
specification.classical_postprocessing: phi=int(bitstring,2)/2^t, E=-2*pi*phi/dt with unfolding by 2pi/dt multiples, undoing any rescaling and constant shifts.
assumptions: Tiny instance N=3, t=4 chosen by me
Hard-core boson spin mapping, blocked levels ignored
Controlled evolution built from standard gates; controlled-U^(2^k) is implemented by repeating controlled steps
Sign/shift conventions between eq_1 and eq_2 need fixing in implementation
